title: 1:1 prep - Jordan Lee (report: Aisha Rahman)
content:
Goal: 20-30m 1:1. Quick sync on status + unblock + career check-in. Keep it informal, leave time for Aisha's topics and career growth.

Agenda (rough):
- Quick wins / wins since last 1:1 (2-3 min)
  - shipping small KV cache fix (INF-482) - check rollforward/stage metrics
  - PR 239 landed? verify perf numbers in staging
- Current focus & priorities (5-7 min)
  - Aisha working on throughput regression (INF-501)
  - Ramp plan for quantization experiment (q2 spike)
- Blockers / risks (5 min)
  - need test infra access for perf harness on dedicated nodes (ticket raised)
  - flaky CI on nightly perf runs - might hide regressions
- Career / growth (5-8 min)
  - check interest in leading small project (kv-cache perf spike / owning rollouts)
  - discuss stretch goal: mentoring intern for summer (pairing plan)
- Action items & next steps (2-3 min)
  - confirm owners and due dates before wrap-up

Notes / prompts to ask Aisha: 
- How confident are you in the INF-501 root cause hypothesis? Do you need extra pair time or a second set of eyes on perf traces?
- Which part of the perf regression feels most reproducible? (sequence length / batch sizing / kernel selection)
- For the quantization experiment, do you have a minimal experiment plan (dataset, target metrics, rollback criteria)?
- Would you be interested in owning the KV cache rollout for Dedicated next quarter? What support would you need?

Current context / quick data to reference in 1:1: 
- Staging throughput (tokens/sec) baseline: ~18k tokens/sec (last week)
- Current observed in INF-501 runs: down ~12% on median latency at seq=512 
- Error budget: 99.9th latency SLO is 120ms; tail is spiking to ~140ms in noisy nodes
- CI: nightly perf harness run ID: nightly-2026-02-25 (link in Slack thread)

Open items to bring up with me (manager):
- I can allocate 1 day pair-debug time this week - do you want that?
- I can escalate to infra for dedicated test nodes if we commit a short validation plan
- Align with product on acceptable perf tradeoffs for quantized variants (I can set up short sync)

Draft action items (post-1:1 - fill in during meeting):
- Aisha: create minimal experiment plan for quantization (include dataset, metrics, rollback criteria) - due 2026-03-09
- Jordan: schedule 2-4h pair-debug slot and block calendar - due 2026-03-03
- Aisha: add perf traces + reproducer steps to INF-501 ticket, tag Jordan and infra lead - due 2026-03-05
- Jordan: open short RFC to product for quantization rollout guardrails (1 pager) - due 2026-03-12
- Both: sync with infra about dedicated harness access; attach test plan - due 2026-03-06

Follow-up / reminders for me as manager: 
- Ask about Aisha's interest in leading rollout and what success looks like for her (career signal)
- Remind to nominate her for 'spotlight' in next all-hands for the KV cache fix once confirmed in staging
- Check progress on mentoring plan if she wants to onboard an intern - outline expectations and time commitment

Meeting prep checklist (for me):
- Pull latest staging perf dashboard (console -> serving-runtime -> staging -> throughput/latency)
- Open INF-501 and INF-482 with latest comments pre-meeting
- Bring up PR 239 status and check deploy logs for it
- Confirm pair-debug slot on calendar (block 3h)

Tone notes: keep encouraging, be specific about support, avoid micro-managing; emphasize ownership and impact.

Quick inbox notes to send after 1:1 (templates):
- "Thanks - good sync. Action items: 1) create quantization experiment plan by 2026-03-09, 2) add traces to INF-501 by 2026-03-05, 3) I'll schedule pair-debug for 2026-03-04. I'll follow up in Slack."

Rough timeline: plan to check back in next 1:1 (2026-03-11) and a mid-week async update on 2026-03-06 for blockers.

Misc scratch / talking points: 
- If we can't reproduce regression on staging, escalate to platform infra for node-level analysis and consider bisecting recent kernel changes (list PRs touching kernel selection 230-240).
- Consider temporary routing policy to avoid noisy nodes as short-term mitigation (Jordan to propose routing tweak).

Tags for quick search: 1:1, aisha, perf, kv-cache, quantization, blockers
